explanation: Ran ./eta/build/exclurad on the repository's template input.dat, which was already set to model=3 (EtaMAID), full O(alpha) RC mode, bmom=6.53 GeV, tmom=0.0, lepton=1 (electron), ivec=1 (recoil proton), vcut=0.166 GeV^2 (standard CLAS12 eta settings), with W=1.5753 GeV, Q2=0.3 GeV2, cos(theta*)=-0.527586 at phi*=36, 72, 108 deg. This kinematic point (W=1.5753 GeV) is above the eta production threshold (W_thr = m_p + m_eta = 1.4861 GeV), so it is physical. The run completed cleanly (exit code 0, no NAG/integration errors) and the Born-cross-section consistency check printed by the code (sib/sibt) was 1.00 for all three points. delta and sigma_born are reported verbatim from radtot.dat column 6 (sigar(1)/sibar(1), the ratio of the radiatively-corrected to Born cross section) and column 7 (sibar(1), the unpolarized Born cross section), matching the definitions used in the README's RC Explorer (delta = sigma_obs/sigma_0).
